title: A batch rebuilt on a moved base takes a new batch name; the old batch PR closes
why: Runner 10, 14:53 CST Nov 12 (coordinator relay 14:54): batch #2911 was built, then main moved; it could not be rebuilt on the new base under the same name, so it closed and was rebuilt as batch 107 (#2961).
note: Write the case in skill ci-hygiene step 8 (Batch lanes): a rebuild on a new base closes the old batch PR and opens the next batch number; the merge tool's refusal names that remedy. Red first on a same-name rebuild if the tool allows it.
